prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【海报主题】：{填写主题}
【中文主标题】：{填写标题}
【英文标题】：{填写英文名称}
【核心视觉创意】：{如巨鲸背着书港、茶叶化作茶山、雨伞撑起城市}
【主要画面元素】：{建筑、自然、人物、植物、器物等}
【配色方案】：{主色、辅助色、强调色}
【活动信息】：{日期、地点、副标题、活动内容等}
【画幅比例】：9:16

创作一张具有东亚复古手绘美学的文化活动艺术海报，融合日本与台湾地区独立文化展览海报、复古绘本插画、传统平面印刷和实验性编辑设计的视觉语言。

视觉创意与构图

围绕主题创造一个充满想象力的微缩世界。让日常器物、建筑、植物、自然景观和人物通过尺度变化、形态融合或超现实组合，形成独特而完整的视觉隐喻。

主体必须拥有醒目的大形体与清晰轮廓，可通过环绕、穿插、叠合、局部压角或蜿蜒路径组织画面。

主体内部包含丰富而有意义的生活细节，外围保留自然留白。远看具有强烈的图形识别度，近看能发现有趣的故事。

手绘风格与色彩

采用自由、不完全规整的手绘墨线，结合二维平涂、局部精细线描和艺术化造型。

线条具有自然粗细变化，建筑、树木和人物允许适度夸张、不对称和轻微稚拙感。部分形体使用深色描边，部分直接由完整色块构成，避免机械工整。

以干净温暖的象牙米白纸张为底，搭配草木绿、湖水青、陶土橙、芥末黄、炭黑等复古自然色。

每张海报选择2–3种主要颜色，并用一种醒目的强调色建立视觉焦点。颜色饱满、平涂均匀，保留极轻微的传统印刷质感，避免厚重颗粒与过度做旧。

文字与编辑排版

使用大胆、富有手绘笔触的中文大标题，结合复古英文衬线字体、醒目日期数字和精致的小字号活动信息。

采用不对称、富有节奏的编辑式排版，让文字与插画产生围合、穿插、遮挡或空间呼应，而非简单覆盖在画面上。

标题、日期、地点、活动说明应形成清晰的信息层级。所有文字具有实际意义，构成完整、专业的文化活动海报。

整体质量要求

画面具有成熟独立插画师的原创艺术气质，兼具自由的手绘趣味、鲜活的平面色彩、超现实想象力与专业排版。

保持统一的系列美学，但允许不同主题拥有独立的构图、色彩和视觉创意。

避免普通儿童卡通、3D微缩模型、CG渲染、照片写实、复杂渐变、过度精致的商业插画、随机装饰、无意义文字、四角星芒和模板化排版。

最终输出一张完整、精致、具有收藏价值的9:16高清竖版艺术海报。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

请创作一张 9:16 日式木版画美术馆展览海报。

中文主题：【填写】
英文主标题：【填写】
英文副标题：【填写】
日文标题：【填写】
艺术主体：【填写】
主体动态：【填写】
主色调：【填写】
展览日期与场馆：【填写】

采用日本传统木版画、浮世绘与高级展览编辑设计美学。

暖象牙白艺术纸背景，黑色高对比 Didone 巨型衬线字横贯顶部，占据约 22% 高度；右侧以巨大现代宋体竖排中文展名，搭配细小日文与精致分隔线。

中央是一幅占据画面约 60% 面积的巨大木版画主体，具有鲜明轮廓、连续动势、浓郁限定色彩、细致传统刻线及丰富空间层次。

主体必须真实穿过顶部英文字母，通过前后遮挡与负空间形成强烈的图文互动，保持标题清晰可读。

左侧安排有意义的中文短句、日文说明及英文艺术分类，利用字号变化、细线和精密间距形成高信息密度编辑排版。

底部约 17% 高度设置巨大衬线数字展期，以及完整的场馆、展厅、开放时间和艺术类别信息网格。

整体强调大字、强主体、图文穿插、留白与细密信息的对比。保留干净纸张纹理、真实套色印刷和完整色块。

生成具有收藏级美术馆展览品质的完整海报，禁止乱码、过度做旧、装饰性编号、水印、四角星芒及 Mockup。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】：{青瓷 / 传统服饰 / 宣纸 / 砚石 / 其他东方文化材质}
【中文标题】：{4–6 字主题名称}
【英文标题】：{对应英文展览标题}
【核心主体】：{器物 / 织物 / 纸张 / 材质对象}
【辅助档案】：{线稿 / 古画 / 山水 / 结构图 / 材质研究 / 文献等}
【主色调】：{月白灰青 / 浅玉色 / 暖米灰 / 墨黑等}
【核心构图】：{景深留白 / 对角悬浮 / 纸层拼贴 / 大块材质裁切等}
【画幅比例】：9:16

设计一张高级东方文博编辑海报，将传统东方器物、织物、纸张或自然材质重新组织进当代博物馆展览、艺术出版物与文化研究视觉系统中。

整体视觉强调“克制、留白、材质与信息层级”，不是传统中国风装饰海报，也不是普通产品展示。

背景使用温润干净的暖象牙白、月白或极浅灰白艺术纸 / 展览空间，只保留极轻微真实纸张、织物或自然材质纹理，不做旧、不脏、不泛黄。

采用成熟的非对称编辑网格，让【核心主体】通过放大、裁切、悬浮、透光、虚焦、叠层、斜向进入或局部超出画面的方式参与构图。不要规整居中完整展示，而要让主体本身成为版式结构的一部分。

根据【核心构图】建立明确空间关系：

可使用前景虚化、中景主体、远景轮廓形成景深；
可使用半透明纸层、织物、玻璃或自然投影形成叠层；
可使用大块材质切面、留白和阴影形成抽象几何关系；
可让主体的轮廓、褶皱、边缘、孔洞、纹理或结构线自然参与文字排版。

Typography 使用现代宋体 / 明朝体与高对比 Serif 英文字体混排。

中文标题作为主要或次要视觉锚点，根据画面选择横排、竖排、错位或大尺度局部排列；英文标题承担另一层编辑层级。不要所有文字等大，要形成明显的“大标题 × 中型说明 × 极小档案信息”尺度差异。

在留白区域加入少量真正有意义的展览信息、材料研究、制作方式、文化说明和机构信息，使画面接近真实博物馆图录、艺术出版物或研究型展览视觉，而不是使用随机英文或 Lorem Ipsum。

加入与主题相关的【辅助档案】，例如：

器物轮廓线稿、山水档案、传统服饰结构图、材质截面、纸张纹理、拓片、手稿、器形分类、工艺研究图等。

所有辅助内容必须降低对比度、局部裁切、半透明化，只作为第二层或第三层信息，不与主体竞争。

色彩使用低饱和东方材质色，根据主题控制在 3–5 个主要色阶以内。例如：

暖象牙白 + 月白 + 灰青；暖米白 + 浅玉色 + 墨灰；暖白 + 淡茶褐 + 石灰；暖白 + 墨黑 + 浅石色。

不要为了“东方感”堆叠大量红、金、青绿等传统色。

画面必须建立清楚的三级观看关系：

远看：
主体大形、标题和留白首先成立，缩略图状态下仍然有明确视觉重心。

中距离：
能够发现材质、光影、景深、投影、裁切和主体与 Typography 之间的空间关系。

近距离：
才能阅读档案信息、研究标签、线稿、材质说明和细小文字。

保持约 45%–60% 的有效留白，但留白必须受到主体方向、光线、材质边界和文字网格的控制，不能只是单纯空着。

最终效果像亚洲顶级美术馆、设计博物馆、传统工艺研究机构或高级独立艺术出版物制作的东方文博展览主视觉：

传统对象经过当代编辑设计重新组织，安静、克制、真实、有空气感、有知识性，同时具有完整的作品感和成熟的信息层级。

避免：传统中国风模板、主体完整居中、商业产品广告、电商展示、红金配色堆叠、祥云边框、满屏书法、过度做旧、脏污纸张、CGI 塑料材质、强烈奢侈品高光、随机英文、信息过少、模板化极简、编号、No.、Vol.、四角星芒。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Prompt:

TITLE: [DROP / PASSAGE / BEND / RISE-FALL / your own text]
PROJECT NAME: [brand / exhibition / campaign]
ARCHITECTURAL SPACE: [atrium / passage / curved ramp / vertical canyon / other]
TYPE MOTION: [fall / recede / bend / rise / opposing directions]
SUBJECT: [small human figure / skater / none]
MAIN COLOR: [one or two strong accent colors]
SUPPORTING TEXT: [location / date / short tagline]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a high-impact perspective typography poster where oversized type is physically integrated into architecture and uses the structure of the space to create movement, depth and direction.

Build the architecture and perspective system first, then make the typography strictly follow its surfaces, curves, openings, height changes and vanishing directions.

The main word should dominate the composition while remaining readable. Let the letterforms change naturally according to the selected spatial mechanism:

For vertical spaces, make the type expand, compress or fall through different levels.

For passages and repeating openings, let the letters appear, disappear behind structural elements and re-emerge deeper in the scene.

For curved paths, bend and rotate the typography along the changing direction of the architecture.

For opposing directions, use two typographic flows moving against each other within the same spatial system.

Typography should feel painted, printed or embedded into real architectural surfaces, with accurate perspective, scale, occlusion and surface contact. Avoid simply placing flat text over the image.

Use a restrained architectural palette with one or two strong accent colors against concrete, black, white or neutral materials. Keep the letterforms bold, geometric and visually dominant.

If a person is included, keep them relatively small and use them as a scale anchor. Their movement or position should reinforce the direction of the typography rather than compete with it.

Add only a small amount of editorial information such as project name, location, date and one short thematic line.

Overall style: perspective typography, architectural poster, spatial graphic design, editorial composition, strong depth, clear hierarchy and bold visual impact.

She is wearing a loose, solid red t-shirt with a slightly worn effect that falls just above mid-thigh, creating a careless and cozy look. The fabric of the T-shirt is soft, with a matte surface, its texture is clearly felt. She raised one hand to her face, hiding it behind a smartphone, which creates an intriguing feeling, and the other hand rests on her waist, emphasizing a slight asymmetry in the pose. The hair is gathered in a high careless bun, with individual strands sticking out, which adds naturalness and ease. The room is illuminated by a soft diffused light that falls muffled from above and slightly from the right, creating subtle shadows on the wall and inner curves of the wrist and knee bones, highlighting the volume and liveliness of the scene. In the background, a light smooth door with thin horizontal black stripes is visible, which adds graphic accent to the composition, despite the severity and conciseness of the setting. The floor is made of light marble with a delicate pattern reflecting a faint gloss, which harmoniously combines with the overall cool palette. The mood of the frame is calm and contemplative, conveying a moment of inner solitude and light thoughtfulness, and the soft lines of clothing and natural poses give the photo a sense of home comfort and intimacy, photorealistic image, high texture detailing, high quality, 8K resolution.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Prompt:

【主题】：____
【四字中文标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【核心主体】：____
【主体表现方式】：摄影 / 插画 / 版画 / 拼贴 / 混合媒介
【辅助纹样】：____
【主色调】：____
【点缀色】：____
【日期 / 机构 / 辅助信息】：____
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有成熟文化展览与编辑设计气质的「压角构图」海报。核心视觉由一个强主体、巨型中文 Typography、边缘信息和留白共同组成，让文字不只是标题，而是真正成为画面的边界和构图结构。

主体占画面约 45%–60%，保持完整、有明确轮廓和视觉重量，不要为了构图故意扭曲或切碎。根据主题选择真实摄影、版画、插画或混合媒介表现，并让主体本身具备足够强的识别度和作品感。

将【四字中文标题】拆开分布在画面四角或边缘，但不要四字等大、等距、完全对称。选择 1–2 个字作为主要压力点，大幅放大并局部裁出画面；其余文字作为次级回应。允许主体与大字发生真实穿插，例如人物、动物、器物、浪花、枝条或衣袖从字形前后穿过，让“字在主体后面、主体又从字中长出来”，形成丰富的前后空间关系。

英文标题、日期、机构、说明文字集中在 2–3 个边缘区域，可混合横排、竖排和极小字号。通过超大中文、中号英文、极小信息形成强烈字号反差，不要把所有小字排成整齐栏目，也不要平均撒满全图。

整张图只使用一套与主题直接相关的辅助纹样，例如面具主题使用鼓点放射纹，山野主题使用角形或植物线稿，海洋主题使用波浪纹，风物主题使用风线。辅助纹样可以重复、放大、裁边或淡化，但不要同时加入多套无关装饰。

背景不能完全空白，可加入极淡纸张纹理、印刷颗粒、主题线稿、图案残影或少量档案信息，让留白“有内容”，但远看仍然保持主体清晰。

色彩控制在 3–4 个主要颜色，建立明确色彩立场。主体、巨字和背景之间要有足够反差，同时避免过多颜色互相竞争。

整体阅读顺序必须清楚：
第一眼看到强主体和巨型压角文字；
第二眼发现主体与文字之间的遮挡、穿插和异形关系；
第三眼才阅读英文、日期和辅助信息。

目标效果：东亚文化展览海报、编辑设计、艺术出版物感；信息丰富但不乱，大字、主体和留白互相咬合，边缘有压力、中心有聚焦。即使去掉所有小字，画面本身仍然应该是一件完整成立的视觉作品。

[Visual Relationship]: {Interlocking, mirrored, hidden, or transforming forms}
[Book Title]: {English title}
[Tagline]: {Short literary sentence}
[Author]: {Fictional author name}
[Accent Color]: {One subtle highlight color}
[Aspect Ratio]: 9:16

Create a striking literary book cover combining sophisticated optical illusions, intricate vintage engraving, and elegant editorial typography.

Composition & Optical Illusion

Merge two distinct subjects into one unified composition using figureground reversal, shared contours, interlocking silhouettes, and clever negative space.

Let one subject's outline reveal or define the other, creating a doubleimage illusion that rewards a second look.

Use flowing curves, asymmetrical balance, and seamless visual transitions. Both subjects must remain recognizable.

Engraving & Details

Apply intricate scratchboard engraving, delicate crosshatching, and rich grayscale shading.

Render hair, facial features, fur, feathers, architecture, or natural textures with precise directional lines.

Combine richly detailed focal areas with bold silhouettes and clean negative spaces. Strong visual impact from a distance, exquisite details up close.

Color & Atmosphere

Use deep black, warm ivory, and layered charcoalgray tones. Add a tiny amount of the selected accent color to one meaningful detail.

Maintain a mysterious, poetic atmosphere with refined matte print texture.

Typography

Include an elegant serif tagline at the top, a large italic serif title integrated into the artwork, the author's name in uppercase serif lettering, and a small "A NOVEL" label below.

Ensure accurate spelling, elegant spacing, and clear readability.

Final Requirements

Prioritize visual duality, shared boundaries, intricate engraving, and sophisticated literary design.

Output one complete, flat 9:16 book cover, without mockups.

Prompt:

Create a 9:16 retro-tech editorial poster about communication and physical digital interfaces.

Device: [DEVICE]
Headline: [MAIN TITLE]
Concept: [SIGNAL / CALL / INPUT / CONNECTION]
Accent color: [ONE COLOR]

Use a warm off-white editorial background with a realistic retro communication or input device as the hero object. Reference 1990s–2000s technology magazines, telecom manuals, industrial catalogs, Y2K editorial design, and Neo-Swiss typography without copying any existing poster.

Use oversized black typography as part of the composition. Let cables, antennas, signal paths, transparent housings, buttons, screens, or device edges cross through, hide behind, or interrupt the letters so the typography and object feel physically connected.

Visualize the device’s function through meaningful graphics: call timelines, signal paths, cursor movement, dial-up handshakes, connection states, coordinates, waveforms, technical diagrams, status LEDs, interface labels, or hardware specifications. Keep these details small and precise rather than turning the poster into a futuristic UI.

Limit the palette to black, warm white, neutral hardware tones, and one accent color. Keep the product photography realistic with believable transparent plastic, circuitry, metal, cables, screens, and minor material imperfections.

Maintain a strong editorial hierarchy with one dominant object, one dominant headline, a few functional graphic elements, and dense but controlled micro typography. Use clean grids, deliberate cropping, and a small amount of negative space to keep the layout sharp.

Avoid real logos, random text, excessive grunge, heavy distressed printing, cyberpunk neon, multiple accent colors, generic sci-fi HUDs, sparkle symbols, and ordinary centered product-ad layouts.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Prompt:

Create a 9:16 editorial collage poster built around a fan-shaped composition.

SUBJECT: [your theme / subject]
TITLE: [main title]
CONCEPT: [what the composition should express]
FAN STRUCTURE: [fragmented burst / rounded fan pages / diagonal collage / constructivist radial / custom variation]
VISUAL MATERIALS: [portrait photography / botanical specimens / architecture / objects / archival images / textures]
COLOR SYSTEM: [2–5 dominant colors]
TYPOGRAPHY: [editorial serif / grotesk / condensed sans / other]
BACKGROUND: [paper tone / flat color]
TEXT DETAILS: [optional short meaningful phrases]

Treat the fan shape as the main visual system, not as a decorative frame. Build one strong large-scale silhouette first, then place rich visual information inside or around it.

Do not default to evenly spaced straight wedges. The fan structure may be irregular, curved, rounded, fragmented, asymmetrical, layered, partially broken, or constructed from mechanical lines depending on the concept.

Let the geometry carry meaning:

* fragmented shapes can suggest media, memory or visual overload
* rounded fan pages can suggest growth, nature or unfolding
* diagonal sections can create tension and narrative movement
* precise radial lines can suggest systems, architecture or construction

Combine photography, cropped details, textures, linework, flat color fields and negative space with clear hierarchy. Some sections may contain dense imagery, while others should remain pure color or empty space to create rhythm.

Use bold cropping, scale shifts and a few controlled elements crossing the fan boundaries so the composition feels designed rather than like photos placed inside containers.

Keep the color palette intentional and sectional. Each major area should have a clear color identity without becoming visually noisy.

Typography should feel integrated into an art poster or independent editorial publication. Use one clear title and only a small amount of meaningful supporting text. Avoid placeholder copy, excessive labels, UI-style information boxes or random tiny text.

The finished image should work at two distances:
from far away, the fan-shaped structure is immediately recognizable and visually striking;
up close, the viewer discovers layered photography, materials, details and narrative meaning.

Aim for experimental editorial design, art-poster quality, strong thumbnail impact and high information density without clutter.

prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】：填写，例如「风迹 / 汲泉 / 苔庭 / 松间」
【中文主标题】：填写 2–4 个字
【英文标题】：填写
【自然主题元素】：填写，例如风、水、苔藓、松木、山石、草穗
【前景立体实物】：填写，例如石钵、苔石、枯木、薄纸、植物
【摄影窗口场景】：填写，例如雾中山林、山涧、草坡、松林
【主色调】：填写低饱和自然色
【画幅比例】：默认 9:16

生成一张东方自然文化主题的 Editorial Design 艺术海报。

整体采用暖象牙米白艺术纸背景，保留轻微天然纸纤维与克制的印刷颗粒，大面积留白，画面安静、自然、松弛、有文化感。

画面上方或偏右放置巨大的中文手写书法标题【中文主标题】，使用自由、真实、有毛笔提按变化与墨迹浓淡的现代东方书写方式，让中文大字本身成为主要视觉锚点。

搭配纤细优雅的英文 Serif 字体呈现【英文标题】，再加入少量有实际意义的中文短句、英文说明和日期信息，形成“大书法 + 英文标题 + 小字号编辑文字”的信息层级。

画面中部加入一个大型低饱和自然色块，颜色使用【主色调】。色块边缘具有自然撕纸、山体、地形或有机形态感，保持完整清晰的大形，不要拆成大量碎片。

在色块内部开出一个圆形、椭圆形、竖向或不规则自然窗口，窗口中呈现【摄影窗口场景】的真实摄影画面。摄影区域低对比、低饱和、有薄雾和空气透视感，像透过纸张开孔看见另一个真实自然空间。

画面下部加入真实立体的【前景立体实物】，具有真实材质、体积、接触阴影和自然空间关系。

让真实立体物局部遮挡二维色块或摄影窗口，形成明显的前后层次：

艺术纸背景 → 平面色块 → 自然摄影窗口 → 真实立体实物。

主题围绕【自然主题元素】展开，让所有视觉元素共同表达一个清楚的自然概念，而不是简单堆砌装饰。

整体版式采用不对称 Editorial Design，文字散落在留白区域，可以加入少量纵向排版、边缘排版和超小字号信息，但所有文字都应具有真实意义。

配色控制在暖米白、低饱和自然主题色、石灰灰、灰褐、墨褐等范围，整体哑光、柔和、稳定，不使用高饱和颜色。

保留轻微 Offset Print、艺术纸、手工印刷与纸本出版物质感，但不要过度做旧。

最终效果应像真正完成的自然文化展览海报：远看首先看到巨大书法标题、完整色块和清楚的立体自然物，近看才发现摄影窗口、小型文字与材质细节。

Prompt:

Create a bold commercial campaign poster where oversized typography behaves like a real physical object and actively interacts with the subject.

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product: [PRODUCT]
Main Word: [SHORT WORD]
Subject: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Motion Type: [SWING / FLEX / FLIP / ROLL / OTHER]
Main Color: [COLOR]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Use realistic commercial photography, oversized typography, strong perspective, vivid color contrast, and contemporary editorial design.

Make the main word extremely large and give it one clear physical behavior:

 SWING: suspend the letters and let them move like swinging gates while the subject passes between them.
 FLEX: let the letter surface bend smoothly under the subject’s weight, then visibly rebound.
 FLIP: rotate different letters around simple pivot axes and reveal a contrasting back surface.
 ROLL: turn a round letter into a rolling typographic form that moves through the scene and interacts with real wheels or objects.

The subject must physically react to the typography through stepping, dodging, balancing, riding, or making contact with it.

Keep the typography clearly readable. Use clean matte surfaces, even colors, sharp edges, and controlled depth. Avoid rough concrete, distressed textures, scratches, dirt, random noise, and heavy 3D architecture.

All motion arcs, guide lines, callout lines, and curves must be smooth, continuous, and clearly rendered.

Keep people highly realistic with natural anatomy, believable proportions, real skin texture, controlled highlights, detailed hair, and authentic clothing materials. Avoid waxy skin, oily reflections, CGI appearance, distorted limbs, oversized hands or feet, and extreme wide angle deformation.

Use one dominant high impact color, one contrasting accent color, and black or white for balance. Add only a few meaningful campaign details such as the brand name, product name, slogan, and 2 to 3 short feature callouts.

The final image should feel like a finished campaign key visual where typography, motion, and the subject behave as one physical system.

Avoid generic subject plus big text layouts, random motion effects, broken lines, unreadable typography, cluttered UI, rough materials, unrealistic anatomy, and meaningless filler text.

提示词：

【主题】：____
【中文标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【左侧元素】：____
【右侧元素】：____
【中轴内容】：____
【夹景方式】：人物动作 / 光影投射 / 正负对照 / 烟雾气流 / 实体轮廓
【主色调】：____
【辅助色】：____
【日期 / 场馆】：____
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有强设计感和文化展览气质的「中轴夹景」海报。画面建立清晰稳定的垂直中轴，让左右两侧的视觉元素共同把视线推向中央。两侧不只是做对称装饰，而是真正参与主题表达，可以是人物、水袖、烟气、器物、建筑、投影、材质轮廓，或者同一主题的不同状态。

根据主题灵活选择夹景方式：
人物动作可以用姿态、衣袖、布料和身体曲线夹出中央负形；
光影投射可以让两侧阴影或亮面对中央形成收束；
正负对照可以用原版与成品、实体与印痕、反刻与正印形成中轴关系；
烟雾气流可以让两股连续上升或回旋的线条围绕中央；
实体轮廓则通过器物、建筑或自然形态的边缘共同围出中心区域。

标题必须是画面核心，并且真正参与构图。可以使用大字纵排、横排、错位排版、上下拆分或跨区排版，不要每次都套用同一种“四字标题”格式。文字允许和主体轻微穿插、遮挡、贴边，但要保持清晰可读。

整体信息密度要比普通海报更丰富，可在中轴、边栏和底部加入少量展览信息，也可以增加一个小型研究模块，例如动作轨迹、工艺步骤、气流变化或结构示意，让画面更像成熟的 museum poster 和 editorial design。

Prompt : Create a visually stunning 20-second surreal science-fiction mystery film using the four supplied images as environmental references. Maintain the same abandoned motel, dense turquoise-green fog, glowing orange-red neon, vintage CRT monitors, hanging cables, and atmospheric analog technology throughout.
SHOT 01 | 00:00–00:02 | THE MOTEL
Extreme wide cinematic shot. A solitary man in a long dark coat approaches an isolated roadside motel through thick rolling cyan fog. The red MOTEL sign flickers overhead. Wet asphalt reflects the neon. Slow low-angle dolly forward.
SHOT 02 | 00:02–00:04 | THE CALL
Interior macro close-up. A dusty black rotary telephone suddenly rings on an abandoned reception desk. Its cable lies unplugged beside it. A small red indicator light blinks in perfect rhythm with the ringing.
SHOT 03 | 00:04–00:06 | THE INSTRUCTION
Tight profile shot of the man lifting the telephone receiver. Through crackling analog static, a distorted recording of his own voice whispers: "Channel nine." His eyes slowly shift toward a glowing terminal in the darkness.
SHOT 04 | 00:06–00:08 | THE FREQUENCY
Extreme close-up of his fingers rotating a large metallic tuning dial. The terminal displays "CH 09". Its screen erupts with white static, then reveals a quiet, sunlit road outside the motel. Warm golden light spills onto his fingers.
SHOT 05 | 00:08–00:10 | THE IMPOSSIBLE WINDOW
A dramatic wide shot reveals an enormous wall of stacked CRT televisions. Every screen shows dense blue-green fog except one central television displaying brilliant golden daylight. The man stands silhouetted before the glowing screens. Slow symmetrical camera push-in.
SHOT 06 | 00:10–00:12 | THE DISCOVERY
Side-profile close-up. The man gently places his palm against the sunlit television. Instead of solid glass, the screen ripples like liquid mercury. Warm sunlight illuminates his face while the surrounding room remains cold and green.
SHOT 07 | 00:12–00:14 | THE CROSSING
Smooth over-the-shoulder tracking shot. The man steps carefully through the glowing television surface. The golden light envelops him. The surrounding CRT screens flicker simultaneously as he disappears into the image.
SHOT 08 | 00:14–00:17 | THE ESCAPE
Cut to the exterior. The man emerges onto the empty motel road, now bathed in beautiful golden morning sunlight. The thick fog slowly dissolves. He looks at the open sky, visibly relieved. The camera gently orbits him as natural birdsong replaces the electrical humming.
SHOT 09 | 00:17–00:20 | THE TWIST
The camera suddenly pulls backward, faster and faster. The beautiful sunlit road shrinks into the curved glass of a vintage CRT television. We are still inside the original dark control room. The same man's silhouette sits motionless in a chair, watching his own escape on Channel 09.
The screen flickers once.
Cut to black.
VISUAL LANGUAGE:
Photorealistic 35mm film, vintage anamorphic lenses, dense volumetric fog, deep emerald shadows, icy cyan highlights, orange-red neon, physical CRT bloom, subtle halation, wet reflective textures, realistic analog machinery. Precise cinematic blocking, striking silhouettes, slow controlled camera movement, seamless transitions, no artificial-looking CGI.
SOUND DESIGN:
Wind through deserted streets, rotary telephone ringing, magnetic tape hiss, electronic frequency sweeps, low atmospheric synthesizer drone, gentle birdsong during the apparent escape, and a final single CRT shutdown click.
CONTINUITY:
One adult male protagonist, consistent dark coat and hairstyle. No children, violence, injury, dangerous actions, or threatening figures. No narration or subtitles. Only minimal diegetic screen text. Exactly nine shots, totaling 20 seconds.

Prompt:

Create a bold editorial campaign poster where oversized typography behaves like a physical material instead of remaining flat and static.

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]
Main Word: [SHORT WORD]
Subject: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Material Behavior: [FOLD / PEEL / SPLIT / REFLECT / OTHER]
Main Color: [COLOR]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Campaign Details: [SLOGAN / SPECS / DATE]
Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Use realistic commercial photography, oversized typography, strong high-contrast colors, and contemporary editorial design.

Make the main word extremely large, filling roughly 50–75% of the composition. Let the typography physically react according to the selected material behavior:

 FOLD: create clean creases and folded planes that follow the product or subject’s structural direction.
 PEEL: build several clean color layers and let the top layer lift away to reveal what is underneath.
 SPLIT: divide the typography into several large strips and shift them in alternating directions while keeping the subject visually intact.
 REFLECT: turn the letterforms into flat mirrored surfaces that realistically reflect the subject, product, and surrounding colors.

Create strong foreground–subject–background interaction so the person or product feels physically connected to the typography.

Use one dominant color with black, white, and one contrasting accent color. Add only a few meaningful campaign details such as the brand name, product name, slogan, specifications, or small editorial labels.

Keep people, products, materials, lighting, and reflections realistic and polished.

The final image should feel like a finished campaign key visual — bold, colorful, layered, and conceptually clear.

Avoid generic subject + big text layouts, random deformation, heavy 3D lettering, meaningless filler text, excessive UI graphics, clutter, and disconnected visual effects.

Prompt:

TITLE: [VOLUME / ANGLE / FOLD / CUT / your own title]
MODEL: [model appearance, hairstyle, attitude]
GARMENT: [sculptural couture / architectural tailoring / oversized outerwear / flowing fashion]
TYPE INTERACTION: [overlap / cut through / frame / conceal / pass through / wrap around]
PALETTE: [neutral base + black + one strong accent color]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a premium high-fashion editorial poster where the model, garment, typography and negative space are designed as one composition.

Start with a strong fashion silhouette rather than a conventional standing pose. Give the model a confident, detached editorial attitude and a clear body gesture such as a long stride, torso twist, asymmetric stance or controlled mid-motion pose. The clothing should have a distinctive sculptural shape through oversized volume, architectural shoulders, exaggerated draping, sharp tailoring or large folded fabric planes. Prioritize silhouette and garment structure over simple facial beauty.

Keep the studio environment minimal and refined, using a clean ivory, stone grey or muted neutral background. Build the palette around strong black-and-white contrast with only one controlled accent color such as cobalt blue, scarlet red or muted coral. Keep skin tones natural and realistic, with visible fabric texture, believable folds and polished fashion lighting.

Typography must actively participate in the image rather than sit beside the photograph. Use one dominant oversized word or letterform with extreme scale, paired with very small editorial copy. Let the type overlap the body, disappear behind clothing, reappear through negative space, cross between the model’s limbs, become a frame, or function like an architectural structure the model moves through. Partial cropping and controlled obstruction are encouraged as long as the main word remains recognizable.

Mix one strong display typeface with restrained supporting typography: high-contrast serif, bold grotesk sans serif, small clean sans serif or a subtle italic serif. Keep secondary copy sparse and purposeful. Avoid filling every empty area with text.

Maintain generous negative space, asymmetric balance, strong silhouette readability and a clear visual hierarchy. The first impression should come from one memorable visual event: a giant letter containing the model, typography slicing across a black silhouette, sculptural fabric interrupting a word, or oversized type interacting with a moving body.

The finished image should feel like sophisticated contemporary fashion art direction — bold, elegant, graphic, expensive and editorial, with the polish of a premium magazine cover or fashion campaign.

Position her head around the upper-middle portion of the vertical frame, with the torso extending downward and one bent thigh and knee entering prominently into the lower foreground.  Her hair is exceptionally long, dense, and naturally black. Because she is already lying flat, the hair explodes outward above and beside her head, producing a huge irregular black silhouette that resembles a chaotic halo. Do not make the hair form a clean circle. Preserve crossing strands, loose loops, tangles, flyaways, uneven edges, and tiny cool highlights created by the flash. Some notes rest beside her hair, across the shoulders and torso, over the abdomen, and near the legs. Keep the layout messy rather than graphic or symmetrical. Visible skin includes the face, ears, neck, collarbones, shoulders, both arms and hands, parts of the upper arms, midriff, and a large foreground section of thigh and knee. Use a light cool-neutral to lightly warm-neutral ivory complexion, with stronger peach-pink flush across the cheeks. Preserve the reference's softly narrow facial proportions, refined jawline, almond-shaped eyes, natural nose proportions, and full but restrained lips without replacing her with any specific celebrity.  She looks straight upward into the camera with a calm, slightly tired, self-contained gaze. Her lips remain naturally closed or only faintly relaxed apart, without a clear smile. The expression should feel like someone who is completely aware of being photographed after the party has already happened, yet is not trying too hard to perform for the camera.  The most important gesture is one arm reaching aggressively upward toward the camera while offering a single banknote. Because the camera uses a close wide-angle viewpoint, preserve dramatic foreshortening: the hand, thumb, and bill should appear significantly larger than the face. Since the hand is extremely close to the lens, the nearest fingers and banknote may fall slightly out of focus and become slightly brighter or even mildly clipped by the flash. She had already fallen into the scattered bills, and her hair had already spread across the bed. Several notes had landed on her body. Now she is pushing one directly toward the camera, while the other hand is still finishing its movement. A second later, that hand might cover the lens completely or throw the bill back onto the bed.  The final image should combine Y2K flash photography, alt-fashion, luxury parody, money-bed editorial imagery, and a private after-party bedroom snapshot. Keep it cool, visually excessive, slightly absurd, playfully boastful, and imperfect. She wears a minimal white spaghetti-strap cropped cotton camisole that fully covers the breasts, ending around the upper abdomen and exposing the clavicles, shoulders, arms, waist, stomach and navel. She also wears cream-white or pale beige low-rise cotton bikini underwear with tiny scattered floral motifs in muted blue-green, brown-yellow and dusty pink, fully covering the central pelvic area. Keep a slim yet believable adult body with real soft-tissue weight and gravity. Do not exaggerate the breasts, hips or waist. Her abdomen is relaxed, with only subtle contour changes caused by the seated twist.

The pose is loose and asymmetric. Her upper body reclines backward while her body forms a diagonal through the vertical frame. The leg on frame-right is bent and raised very close to the camera, creating natural perspective enlargement of the thigh. The other leg folds across the wooden floor toward the lower-left. One arm reaches toward frame-left while holding an already opened traditional folding fan with pale bamboo or wood ribs and a thin white fan surface; the ribs create a strong radial pattern. The other hand is raised into the upper-right area, casually touching the back of her head and hair. Do not horizontally mirror the composition.

Her head tilts slightly back and turns toward the upper-left. She does not look into the camera; her gaze drifts toward the bright window. Her lips are softly parted. The expression is quiet, absent-minded and faintly introspective, neither smiling nor deliberately seductive.

Use soft East-Asian beauty-editorial makeup styling without implying ethnicity or replacing her identity: clean semi-matte complexion with believable skin texture, relatively straight dark brows, fine black upper eyeliner hugging the lash line with a subtle outer extension, naturally defined lashes, extremely soft taupe-brown eye shading, minimal blush, and muted dusty-rose lips with a faint moisturized sheen. Preserve the original facial proportions, jawline, eye spacing and natural facial asymmetry. Do not turn her into a celebrity face or an overly perfected influencer face.

Her visible skin includes the face, neck, clavicles and upper chest, shoulders, arms, areas near the underarms, full midriff and navel, outer hip edges, thighs, knees, lower legs, ankles and feet. Use a light neutral ivory skin tone. In the strongest window light it becomes softly milky, while shadowed areas shift toward extremely subtle warm gray and beige-pink. The skin should look as though it would feel warm, soft, smooth and faintly velvety, retaining tiny pores, slight tonal variation, natural darkness around joints and believable soft-tissue compression. Avoid plastic, waxy or porcelain skin.

The dominant physical light source is a huge bright window behind and to frame-left. Natural daylight passes through a translucent white sheer curtain, turning the entire window into a giant soft diffused source. Broad soft highlights fall across the window-facing cheek, shoulder, clavicle, arm and legs with very gradual transitions. The opposite side receives only passive bounce from pale walls, beige curtains and the wooden floor. Do not use obvious frontal flash or an artificial studio rim light. Allow the sheer curtain and the brightest window-adjacent highlights to clip slightly into white with subtle natural blooming.

On frame-right, include a heavier beige-gray curtain with subdued gold-brown botanical embroidery or floral detailing. Keep the overall room palette restrained to soft white, pale beige, warm gray and natural wood. The outdoor view should be completely obscured by the glowing sheer curtain.

Photograph it like a real full-frame mirrorless or DSLR image using roughly a 35-50mm prime lens, preferably around a 40mm full-frame field of view, approximately f/2.8-f/4, ISO 200-500 and around 1/125s. Place the camera at seated waist-to-knee height, slightly below chest level, shooting from slightly frame-left. This should produce a mild upward perspective and a believable near-large/far-small effect on the raised foreground thigh.

Use a 3:4 vertical composition. Let the subject nearly fill the frame. Do not perfectly center or symmetrize the body. Allow limbs to approach the frame edges, preserve minor accidental-looking cropping and uneven visual weight. The opened fan on frame-left counterbalances the large foreground leg on frame-right.

Use moderately shallow depth of field rather than extreme bokeh. Keep the face, torso and major areas of the legs readable and detailed, while the curtains and floral bolster soften only slightly and still retain visible texture. Preserve subtle digital grain, restrained sharpness, tiny amounts of shadow noise and slight highlight clipping. Avoid HDR, aggressive clarity and flawless commercial retouching.

She had already been sitting beside the window for a while. Afternoon light had been drifting through the sheer curtain. Now she is looking upward toward the window, the opened fan still resting in her hand; a moment later, she may begin moving it again. The final image should carry low energy, warmth, stillness and the residue of an unspoken thought — as though the photographer were sitting nearby on the same floor and happened to capture this moment, rather than directing a perfectly controlled studio pose.

prompts.text:
提示词：

生成一张 9:16 竖版高级情绪摄影艺术海报。

【人物】：成年年轻东亚女性
【场景】：城市夜色 / 玻璃温室 / 夏末麦田 / 酒店长廊 / 其他场景
【服装】：简洁轻盈的夏季服装
【花束】：花材、颜色与形态
【主色调】：场景主色 + 花束点缀色
【情绪】：流逝 / 静谧 / 盛放 / 余温 / 其他
【中文标题】：稍纵即逝的烂漫
【英文副标题】：BEFORE IT FADES

整体采用写实 Editorial Photography × 情绪艺术海报视觉语言，不是普通人物写真或商业广告。

人物保持真实自然的五官、皮肤纹理和身体比例。核心使用“局部清晰 + 动态残影”的摄影方式：人物身体、肩颈、手部和部分花束保持相对清晰；头发、脸部边缘、衣摆或动作方向产生自然的慢速快门 motion blur、轻微双重曝光和时间错位效果。

不要整个人平均模糊。脸部主体仍然需要可辨认，只让局部五官、发丝或轮廓产生方向明确的残影，让画面像同时记录了两个非常接近的时间节点。

花束作为情绪视觉锚点，中心花朵相对清晰，外围花瓣、枝叶可以出现少量动态拖影。花束颜色与场景形成明确的冷暖或明暗对比。

背景根据场景产生不同的流动效果，例如交通灯光横向拉丝、植物前景掠过、麦田和裙摆随风流动、走廊灯光形成时间残影。背景需要有运动和空气感，但不要抢过人物。

构图保持不完全对称和自然留白，人物放在画面一侧，另一侧留给标题与环境。加入克制的中文竖排标题和小号英文副标题，使用现代宋体 / 细衬线字体，让部分发丝、光影或环境残影轻微穿过文字区域，使 Typography 与摄影自然融合。

整体低饱和、电影感、真实、诗意、有情绪张力。画面既要有人物美感，也要有时间正在流逝的感觉。

prompts.text:
prompt：http://promptsref.com/tool/AI-Image-Generator/share/bcb0dd422e3f1515b78c4ee23666f784

Create an authentic vertical 9:16 close-range smartphone portrait of an explicitly adult young woman, combining restrained classical East-Asian-inspired styling with the intimacy of a modern phone selfie. She is seated beside a window in a quiet private interior, leaning noticeably forward toward the lens. Place the camera extremely close, around slightly below face level or upper-chest height, using a mild upward angle. Reproduce the perspective of a 24–28mm full-frame-equivalent smartphone front camera: keep the face relatively natural while allowing the broad sleeve extending toward the camera to become visibly enlarged in the lower-right foreground.  Preserve a small, softly shaped natural face, slight real-world facial asymmetry, a clean but not artificially sharp jawline, and normally proportioned eyes. Her head tilts gently toward image-right, with the chin very slightly raised. She looks directly into the lens with relaxed eyelids and clear window catchlights in her dark irises. Her lips remain naturally closed, without an obvious smile. The expression should feel as though she has just leaned closer to glance at the phone and has not deliberately arranged her face for the photograph; the quiet feeling from the previous second still remains.  Use thin, low-saturation East-Asian costume-drama-inspired makeup: soft gray-brown brows, extremely fine brown-black inner eyeliner, light taupe mixed with muted dusty-rose eyeshadow, naturally elongated but not overly dense eyelashes, almost no visible nose contour, a trace of cool-pink cheek color, and softly blurred muted rose-pink lips. Avoid heavy contouring and obvious powder highlighter.  Her hair is long, mostly straight, and nearly black with a deep brown undertone, lightly tied or half-pinned behind the head. Leave irregular wispy long bangs across the forehead and several long strands beside the cheeks. Do not make the hair commercially perfect. Retain many tiny flyaway hairs around the crown, temples, ears, and silhouette. Strong real backlight from the upper-left turns these flyaways into thin silver-white lines, as if a mild draft disturbed the hair a moment earlier and it has not completely settled yet.  Add delicate small floral hair ornaments on both sides. On image-left, use pale petals with a few pastel blue and soft pink beads. On image-right, use a fine gold-toned structure with pearls and several small teardrop-shaped dangling beads. Keep them lightweight and refined. Do not add a visible necklace or large modern statement jewelry.  The adult figure is naturally slender. Visible skin includes the full face, neck, both shoulders, collarbones, the upper-chest area down to the garment edge, and only a small amount of upper-arm skin. The skin is fair with a neutral-to-slightly-warm undertone, while blue-gray environmental reflections introduce a subtle cyan-gray cast into the shadow side. The skin should visually and tactilely suggest fine, soft, mildly warm human skin: smooth but not waxy, with extremely subtle pores, tiny facial hairs, local tone variation, and natural softness rather than aggressive beauty filtering.  Dress her in a loose ivory or creamy off-white overlapping classical robe or lightweight Han-inspired garment, with broad sleeves and a naturally draped deep V-shaped neckline. The fabric is soft, lightweight, faintly translucent, and lightly wrinkled. Gravity and the forward-leaning posture cause the neckline to slip naturally off the shoulders, revealing the collarbones and upper chest. Keep the amount of exposed skin exactly within the reference range; do not increase the neckline or create exaggerated chest compression. At the waist, only a small portion of a desaturated pale blue-gray or mint-gray fabric sash is visible. The broad sleeve in the lower-right sits extremely close to the lens, becomes oversized from wide-angle perspective, and catches a bright patch of real sunlight.  Treat the illumination as physical light rather than vague “atmospheric lighting.” The only strong key light is genuine daylight from a real window located upper-left or upper-left-rear of the subject. Slightly cool-white direct sunlight strikes the hair, ear area, left shoulder, collarbones, and part of the foreground sleeve. Allow mild highlight clipping, especially across the left shoulder. Retain soft but clearly physical shadows beneath the chin and along the neck. The cool blue-gray walls act only as weak natural bounce, introducing a faint cyan-gray fill into shadow areas rather than eliminating the shadows. Do not introduce studio three-point lighting, artificial fill lamps, or fake rim lights.  The background is an ordinary quiet private interior rather than a designed set. Use low-saturation cool blue-gray walls and a simple wall-to-ceiling transition, with only a narrow dark edge of a cabinet, doorframe, or furniture piece along image-right. Keep decoration minimal. The background should sit approximately one to two stops darker than the subject and fall gently out of focus while still retaining believable room geometry.  The final photograph should feel like a casual window-side image taken in the morning or earlier part of the day: cool, quiet, soft, restrained, slightly half-awake. The visual tension comes from classical hair ornaments and clothing appearing inside a very modern close smartphone perspective. Preserve accidents and imperfections: flyaway hair, uneven shoulder height, slightly displaced neckline, mild highlight clipping, subtle phone sharpening, tiny digital noise, mild compression texture, slight framing drift, natural facial asymmetry, and foreground wide-angle distortion. She had already leaned into the light; she is looking into the lens now; in the next second she may look away or sit upright again.  Negative prompt: minor, underage appearance, anime eyes, doll face, influencer face, V-shaped jaw, plastic skin, over-smoothed skin, heavy makeup, red lipstick, extreme cleavage, exaggerated breasts, sexualized pose, perfect symmetry, studio lighting, three-point lighting, fake rim light, golden warm lighting, heavy HDR, extreme bokeh, fantasy palace, oversized crown, extra jewelry, visible phone, mirror selfie.

【主题】：____
【中文标题】：____

【右侧主体 / 轮廓】：____
【中轴内容】：月亮 / 水路 / 留白 / 透视通道 / 标题 / 其他____
【夹景方式】：弧线围合 / 自然轮廓 / 建筑透视 / 放射结构 / 其他____
【主色调】：____
【辅助色】：____

【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有强空间感和成熟 Editorial Design 气质的「中轴夹景」文化海报。

核心不是简单把两个主体左右对称摆放，而是利用器物、山势、飞檐、建筑等主体自身的**轮廓、方向和透视关系**，共同围出清晰的中央空间，让“空间本身”成为构图的一部分。

根据主题选择不同夹景方式：

扇面、圆盘等弧形主体，可以利用弧线和放射结构向中央聚拢；
山体、岩壁、树木等自然形态，可以通过不规则轮廓夹出水路、天空或远景；
飞檐、屋顶等建筑构件，可以利用倾斜方向共同托住月亮、太阳或标题；
门、墙、廊道等空间元素，可以通过透视线向中央收束，形成明显纵深。

左右视觉重量保持平衡，但不要机械镜像。允许主体在大小、材质、角度、颜色和裁切方式上明显不同，只要它们共同强化中轴。

中轴不一定放满文字，可以是一轮月、一条河、一段天空、一个人物、一个透视通道，甚至大面积留白。让中央内容足够简单，才能突出两侧轮廓形成的“夹景”。

Typography 根据每张画面的几何结构重新设计，可以使用超大单字、横向标题、左右拆字、贴边排版、跨越留白或沿结构方向排字。避免每张都使用相同的四字纵排，或固定“两字横排 + 两字竖排”的模板。

信息集中在 2–3 个区域，可加入少量建筑剖面、山势线稿、扇骨结构、透视辅助线等研究元素，但必须服务主题，不要做成 PPT 信息图。

整体视觉方向：

Museum Exhibition Poster × Contemporary Editorial Graphic Design × East Asian Cultural Visual

色彩控制在 3–5 个主要颜色，使用明确的大色域和强对比。第一眼看到主体轮廓和中央空间，第二眼读到标题，第三眼发现弧线、山势或透视如何共同建立中轴。

整体要求：高清、干净、结构明确、空间感强、信息丰富但不杂乱。避免机械对称、主体过小、中央塞满文字、固定标题模板、透视混乱、无意义装饰线、脏旧纹理、模糊细节和低完成度 AI 海报感。

Prompt:

TITLE: [your word]
PROJECT: [brand / exhibition / campaign]
SPATIAL SYSTEM: [overlap / continuous ribbon / layered sections / interlacing / other]
MATERIAL: [transparent panels / flexible ribbon / suspended planes / woven bands / other]
SUBJECT: [small human figure / none]
MAIN COLORS: [2–3 colors]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a contemporary perspective typography poster where oversized type is physically constructed through spatial surfaces rather than printed as ordinary flat text.

The main word should occupy roughly 35–55% of the composition. Break its structure across multiple planes, depths or continuous surfaces so the typography becomes readable only from the intended viewpoint.

For chromatic overlap, split the letterforms across two translucent color systems and let their intersections reveal the word.

For a continuous ribbon, use one uninterrupted surface that twists through different depths and visually reconnects into the typography.

For layered sections, divide the word into separate horizontal planes that align into a complete title from one precise viewing height.

For interlacing, use real over-and-under relationships between continuous bands so the visible foreground segments collectively form the letters.

Keep all perspective, depth, occlusion, material behavior and surface continuity physically believable. From other viewpoints, the typography should partially break apart and reveal the actual spatial construction.

Use bold geometric sans-serif letterforms, a restrained architectural environment and a controlled palette with strong graphic contrast.

If a person is included, keep them small and use them mainly as a scale reference, with realistic foreground and background occlusion.

Add only minimal editorial information such as project name, location, date and one short thematic line.

Overall style: perspective typography, spatial graphic design, contemporary installation art, architectural photography, clean hierarchy and strong visual impact.

人物自然站在床边，一条腿作为主要重心，另一条腿轻微向侧前方错开，膝盖放松，使纤细腰身、修长双腿与脚踝形成自然流畅的轻微 S 型线条。一只手自然整理长发或轻搭腰侧，另一只手自然垂落。人物轻轻看向镜头，神态清冷、羞涩、慵懒而松弛，嘴角带若有若无的淡淡笑意。

场景为夜晚的 INS 奶油风设计感卧室。窗外呈深蓝黑色夜景，远处仅有少量模糊城市灯光。室内采用奶油白、浅米色、淡粉色与浅木色搭配，可见柔软床铺、浅色床单、蓬松枕头、半透明窗帘、简洁床头柜、柔软地毯与少量生活小物，空间安静、整洁、私密且具有真实居住感。

主要光源来自床头暖白小夜灯、隐藏式暖白灯带与极弱的窗外冷蓝环境光。柔和暖白光从人物侧前方照亮面部、肩颈、锁骨、胸前、腰腹与双腿，使冷白肌肤保持明亮通透；微弱冷蓝环境光从侧后方勾勒黑发、肩部与身体轮廓，形成克制细腻的暖白主光 × 冷蓝轮廓光。

浅粉色真丝睡衣在暖白灯光下呈现柔和流动的丝绸高光、真实褶皱与细腻材质层次。人物脸部和肌肤保持清晰明亮，高光柔和不过曝，暗部保留细节，背景灯光自然形成柔和散景。

采用 9:16 竖版完整全身构图，摄影机距离适当拉远，从完整头顶、脸部、深 V 上衣、纤细腰腹、真丝短裤、完整修长双腿一直到赤裸双脚全部入镜。人物占画面高度约 80%–88%，头顶与脚底均保留适量安全空间，禁止裁头、裁腿、裁脚。

采用接近平视、略微低机位的自然手机视角，轻微强化 1.73 米高挑身材与修长腿部比例，同时严格控制透视，避免超广角造成腿脚异常拉伸。构图略微倾斜、不完全居中，保留真实手机临时随手拍摄的不完美感。

整体采用夜晚清冷梦核手机摄影质感：低对比、轻微柔焦光晕、局部柔和高光溢出、自然浅景深、轻微颗粒、极轻暗角与边缘失焦。人物面部、身体、双腿与双脚主体保持清晰，仅让发梢和背景灯光产生轻微柔化。

核心关键词： 20–22 岁成年日本女性，1.73 米，高挑纤细，小头小脸，自然 F 罩杯视觉，极白冷白瓷肌，浅粉小波点真丝分体睡衣，短款深 V 上衣，露腰，真丝短裤，修长大长腿，赤脚，不穿鞋袜，完整全身，夜晚奶油风卧室，暖白床头灯，冷蓝环境轮廓光，前置手机随拍，清冷梦核，安静、羞涩、慵懒、私密、松弛。

负面提示词： 半身照，近景裁切，头顶出画，双脚出画，鞋子，袜子，丝袜，长袜，长裤，长款睡衣，上衣遮住腰部，大头，大脸，短腿，五五分身材，脚部异常放大，胸部过度夸张，身体比例失衡，严重广角畸变，丝绸塑料感，衣物穿模，塑料皮肤，过度磨皮，肤色偏黄，灰白死皮，脸部过暗，夜景死黑，严重过曝，严重失焦，多余肢体，多手多脚，多指少指，背景杂乱，AI 伪影，文字，Logo，水印。

prompts.text:
Prompt:

Create a bold editorial campaign poster where oversized typography becomes a physical space the subject can move through and interact with.

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]
Main Word: [SHORT WORD]
Subject: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Spatial Action: [VAULT / WEAVE / EDGE / SPIN / OTHER]
Movement: [DESCRIBE THE SUBJECT’S ACTION]
Main Color: [COLOR]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Use realistic commercial photography, oversized typography, strong perspective, high-contrast colors, and contemporary editorial design.

Make the main word extremely large and transform its letterforms into a believable spatial structure. The subject must physically interact with the typography instead of simply standing in front of it.

Use the selected spatial action as the main visual logic:

 VAULT: turn the letters into obstacles the subject can physically vault over.
 WEAVE: arrange the letters at alternating depths so the subject moves between them.
 EDGE: use narrow letter edges or surfaces as a path the subject carefully moves along.
 SPIN: arrange the typography into a circular or curved track the subject moves around.

Create clear foreground, midground, and background relationships. Let some parts of the typography pass in front of the subject while other letters recede behind them.

Keep the typography clearly readable. Use shallow, controlled depth rather than heavy 3D sculpture. Letter surfaces should be clean, matte, evenly colored, and sharply defined, with no distressed, chipped, dirty, or weathered texture.

All graphic lines, motion paths, callout lines, and curves should be continuous, smooth, and clearly rendered.

Keep the person highly realistic with natural body proportions, believable movement, real skin texture, natural highlights, and detailed hair. Avoid waxy skin, excessive shine, CGI appearance, distorted limbs, oversized hands or feet, and extreme wide-angle deformation.

Use one dominant high-impact color with black, white, and one contrasting accent color. Add only a few meaningful campaign details such as the brand name, product name, slogan, and 2–3 short feature callouts.

The final image should feel like a finished commercial campaign key visual where the typography itself becomes the environment and the subject’s movement explains the word.

prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】：____
【中文主标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【左侧主体】：____
【右侧主体】：____
【中轴内容】：标题 / 人物 / 植物 / 留白 / 其他____
【夹景方式】：圆弧负形 / 空间透视 / 柔性材质 / 双器配重 / 其他____
【背景主色】：____
【主体材质与风格】：____
【日期 / 场馆】：____
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有强视觉冲击和高级文化展览气质的「中轴夹景」海报。

先建立一条明确、稳定的垂直中轴，再让【左侧主体】与【右侧主体】从画面两侧共同形成视觉重量，把主标题、人物、植物或留白区域推向中央。

左右主体必须足够大，靠近画面边缘并允许自然裁切，共同承担主要视觉重量。两侧可以在轮廓、大小、颜色、材质和细节上不同，但整体视觉重量必须平衡，避免简单复制和机械镜像。

根据主题选择不同的夹景方式：

圆形、弧形主体可利用轮廓共同夹出中央负形；
建筑、屏风等空间主体可通过透视形成纵深中轴；
织物、植物等柔性材料可通过自然弯曲形成柔性夹景；
器物、人物或文物可通过左右配重强化中央标题。

中轴必须成为画面最重要的阅读区域。中文主标题使用大胆的大字号，可采用纵排、横竖混排、尺度变化、局部遮挡或与主体轻微穿插，让 Typography 真正参与构图，而不是普通放在顶部。

允许中轴加入一个低权重视觉节点，例如极小人物、花枝、纹样拓片、结构线稿或研究图，让中央既有焦点又有层次，但不要形成第三个同等级主体。

信息密度可以丰富，但集中在 2–3 个区域：中轴核心信息、左右边栏、底部展讯。通过超大标题与极小文字形成明显字号反差，不要把小字平均撒满整个画面。

使用一个明确的大面积主色建立识别度，例如朱红、钴蓝、柠檬黄、草绿、青蓝、深棕或柿子橙。整体控制在 3–5 个主要颜色，通过主体材质、Typography 和极少量点缀色形成对比。

核心原则：不是简单“左右对称”，而是利用两侧视觉重量共同塑造中心。左右负责施压，中轴负责聚焦；结构稳定，但细节允许不同。

整体要求：强中轴、强主体、强色域，设计感明确，信息丰富但不乱，边缘清晰，文字清楚，材质真实，具有成熟文化展览海报与 Editorial Design 的完成度。

prompts.text:
Prompt:

TITLE: [your main word]
PROJECT NAME: [brand / exhibition / campaign]
ARCHITECTURAL STRUCTURE: [vertical fins / separated buildings / staggered platforms / folded planes / other]
TYPE MECHANISM: [slice / span / offset / fold / custom]
SUBJECT: [small human figure / none]
ACCENT COLOR: [one strong solid color]
SUPPORTING TEXT: [location / date / short tagline]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a high-impact perspective typography poster where oversized type is physically integrated into architecture and only becomes visually complete from one intentional camera viewpoint.

Build the architectural structure first, then let the typography strictly follow its real depth, surfaces, angles, gaps, folds and occlusion.

Depending on the selected mechanism, the word can be sliced across multiple vertical planes, span a physical gap between structures, break across staggered platforms, or continue over folded architectural surfaces.

The main word should occupy roughly 35–55% of the composition. Individual fragments may look abstract or incomplete on separate surfaces, but from the intended viewpoint they should visually align into one clear, readable word.

Use bold geometric sans-serif typography with one strong solid accent color against restrained architectural materials such as concrete, black, white or neutral stone.

If a person is included, keep them small and use them mainly as a scale reference. Let architecture naturally hide or overlap part of the figure so they feel physically inside the typographic space.

Add only a small amount of editorial information such as project name, location, date and one short thematic line.

Overall style: perspective typography, spatial graphic design, contemporary architecture, editorial poster, anamorphic installation, strong depth and clean hierarchy.

Avoid floating text, random distortion, weak alignment, decorative 3D extrusion, neon sci-fi effects, excessive filler copy, cluttered backgrounds, watermarks and numbering.

prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】  
【四字中文标题】  
【主视觉材质】金属 / 石材 / 镜面 / 冰体 / 其他硬质材料  
【物理变化】折叠 / 下压 / 破裂 / 折射 / 形变  
【背景主色】  
【字体主色】  
【强调色】  
【英文标题】  
【画面比例】9:16

生成一张具有 **East Asian Contemporary Exhibition Poster、Japanese Experimental Graphic Design、Editorial Art Direction、Corner-Pressure Composition** 气质的实验性竖版海报。核心使用“压角构图”：将【四字中文标题】拆成四个巨大汉字，从左上、右上、左下、右下向画面中心强势压入。四字不要等大、等距或形成四宫格，而是通过不同字号、裁切、出血量和进入中央的深度建立明显的向内压力。

画面中央设置一个体量足够大的【主视觉材质】，并通过【物理变化】真实改变版面。重点不是“把物体放在四个字中间”，而是让材质真正与 Typography 发生关系：镜面可以反射、切分并重组字形；重物可以压低纸面，让文字跟随表面产生真实透视变化；破裂材质可以通过裂片改变文字反射方向；透明冰体可以遮挡、折射并穿过部分笔画。每张作品只选择一种最强的物理机制，不要同时堆叠大量特效。

主体必须具有高度真实的材质细节，例如镜面金属的折面与倒影、石材的重量和颗粒、玻璃或冰的厚度与折射、纸面的凹陷褶皱、裂纹边缘和接触阴影。物理关系必须合理可理解，让观众明确看到“真实材料正在改变字体和版面”，而不是后期数字扭曲、随机 glitch 或普通 3D 装饰。

Typography 分为三个层级：四角巨大中文字负责第一视觉；【英文标题】和中文作品名负责第二层；日期、地点、短句、材料关键词和少量说明负责第三层。使用明显的字号反差、不对称对齐、局部竖排中文、紧凑英文和极细分隔线建立成熟的编辑设计感。信息密度保持中高，但不要平均填满画面，主体附近可以更密，另一部分保留干净负空间。

整体色彩控制在 3–4 个主要层级。【背景主色】形成大面积强色域，【字体主色】建立稳定结构，【主视觉材质】负责真实物理质感，【强调色】只用于少量短线、日期节点或编辑标记。可以加入极轻纸张纹理、胶印颗粒和丝网印刷质感，但不要严重做旧、污渍或朋克拼贴。

最终阅读顺序应为：第一眼看到四角巨字与中央硬质主体形成的强烈大形；第二眼发现材质真的改变了 Typography；第三眼观察反射、压力、裂纹、折射或表面形变；最后阅读英文标题和少量展览信息。缩略图状态下必须有清晰焦点和强烈 Stop-scroll 冲击，放大后又有真实材质和精密排版细节。

避免：机械四宫格、四字完全等大、主体过小、字体和材质彼此分离、普通产品广告、随机数字扭曲、RGB glitch、科技 HUD、复杂参数、Logo、二维码、编号、四角星芒和版权标识。

An adult woman sitting directly on an outdoor red athletics track, photographed as a vertical 3:4 full-body environmental portrait. The photographer is positioned noticeably above and in front of her, looking downward at roughly a 30–45 degree angle from some physical distance, as if the image had been casually taken from the edge of the stands or another elevated position beside the track. Use a mild telephoto or smartphone-telephoto visual language, roughly 70–120mm full-frame equivalent, producing gentle spatial compression. Avoid eye-level framing and avoid the polished look of a commercial fitness campaign.  She sits on the track with one leg extended diagonally a long distance toward the lower-left foreground while the other leg opens sideways toward the right and bends naturally. Her hips and upper thighs rest directly on the rubber surface, her torso leans slightly forward, and her shoulders hang loosely rather than being deliberately pulled back. One hand reaches toward the extended shoe area while the other remains beside the bent leg, appearing to hold or adjust another running shoe. The pose should feel like something that happened after a run, stretch, or training set rather than something designed specifically for the camera.  Her body is slim and lightly athletic, with long arms and legs and subtle functional muscle definition rather than exaggerated fitness-model musculature. Her abdomen and waist remain exposed; the waist is relatively narrow and the stomach naturally flat, but preserve small soft-tissue changes caused by sitting rather than forcing a sculpted six-pack or extreme hourglass proportions. Visible skin includes parts of the face, neck, shoulders, collarbones, upper chest, both arms, abdomen, side waist, and most of both thighs, while the lower legs are largely covered by white knee-high athletic socks.  Her skin is fair to light with a neutral undertone, becoming slightly gray-rose in the diffused daylight rather than orange or deeply golden. Keep real fine skin texture, slight tonal irregularity, subtle pores, and an almost imperceptible post-exercise sheen across the shoulders, arms, and legs. The tactile impression should be smooth and naturally warm from physical activity, with only a faint surface moisture rather than glossy retouching or plastic skin.  She wears a simple black low-neck sports bra with moderately wide straps and matte stretch fabric, fully supporting and covering the bust while naturally exposing the collarbones, upper chest, and a small amount of skin within the neckline. Her bottoms are loose short black athletic shorts with a relaxed side opening or slit and a tiny white logo on one side. The shorts should bunch, shift, and wrinkle naturally because of the seated position; do not replace them with tight yoga shorts.  She wears white knee-high athletic socks and white, black, and gray running shoes. Preserve the impression that one shoe is worn while another shoe is being held or adjusted beside the bent leg. Add a black square smartwatch on one wrist, a very fine necklace with a tiny pendant, and a small amount of finger jewelry.  Her deep-black to very dark brown hair is gathered into a loose low ponytail. Irregular airy bangs fall over the forehead, with fine side strands framing the cheeks and jaw. Her hair looks slightly disturbed by training: some bangs lightly adhere to the skin, the ponytail is relaxed rather than perfectly neat, and several strands kick outward. She wears narrow dark sunglasses that conceal most of her eyes, so do not invent exaggerated eyes or unusual iris colors. Her lips remain relaxed or slightly parted, without an obvious smile. Makeup is minimal and low-saturation, with a lightweight complexion and muted natural rose or dusty-pink lips rather than heavy contour or glamour styling.  The background is almost entirely the muted brick-red to gray-red rubber running track. Several white lane markings travel diagonally across the frame, creating natural perspective and strong geometric lines. Retain the fine granular rubber texture, tiny pale specks, dust, and subtle wear marks. Do not add spectators, stadium buildings, trees, or visually complicated scenery. A large amount of empty track surrounding the subject is essential to the identity of the composition.  Use soft overcast or thin-cloud daylight, with broad skylight falling evenly from above and slightly in front of her. Create wide, low-contrast highlights across the shoulders, collarbones, upper chest, thighs, and knees, while the undersides of the body and folds in the clothing naturally darken. There should be no hard-edged shadows, golden-hour glow, warm orange skin, professional fill light, or dramatic rim lighting. Keep the running track slightly desaturated and dusty brick red rather than vivid synthetic scarlet.  Retain moderate digital sharpness, subtle telephoto compression, faint social-media image compression, and optionally extremely fine grain. Keep the woman clearly focused while the more distant track softens only slightly; because the background is a flat track surface, avoid exaggerated creamy bokeh.  She had just finished part of her training and had already dropped into a recovery stretch, still adjusting her shoe and catching her breath. The photographer pressed the shutter from above just as she lifted her face toward the camera. It feels like an unprepared instant that remained for only a second before she would return to stretching. The final mood should feel tired, quiet, cool, slightly solitary, and casually observational—an athletic social-media candid rather than a polished campaign.  Negative prompt: indoor gym, running pose, standing pose, eye-level camera, low-angle shot, golden hour, warm orange light, studio rim light, polished fitness advertisement, exaggerated muscles, bodybuilder physique, extreme hourglass body, tiny waist, plastic skin, poreless skin, heavy glamour makeup, bright lipstick, big smile, perfect hair, perfect symmetry, oversaturated red track, clean commercial background, extreme bokeh, beauty close-up.

prompts.text:
1/ Character sheets + storyboard

Create two original East Asian fantasy fighters who were once two halves of the same soul. Keep a similar facial structure, but give them opposite visual identities.

Character A:
Elegant and controlled, amber eyes, long dark hair with one braid, layered teal and gray-blue robes, aged bronze ring weapons releasing thin cyan-gold fate threads.

Character B:
Sharp and rebellious, red eyes, short black wolf-cut hair with one braid, asymmetrical cinnabar-red and bone-white battle robes, a black-gold curved chain blade.

Create detailed full-body character sheets with front, side and back views, facial close-ups, costume materials and weapon details.

Then create a 16:9 pencil action storyboard with 16 tightly arranged panels and minimal gaps.

Show close-ups, vertical drops, wrist kicks, knockbacks, chain-assisted re-entry, leg traps, curtain impacts, corridor chases, weapon locks, roof crashes and a final wide shot.

Use extreme perspective, low angles, weapon POV, over-the-shoulder tracking and partial-body framing.

Clear attack → reaction → recoil → re-entry.

Monochrome graphite pencil sketches, rough animation keyframes, motion lines, impact marks and English labels only.

2/ Seedance prompt

15-second, 16:9, high-energy hand-drawn anime fight with fluid Sakuga-style motion.

Use the character sheets to lock both fighters’ faces, costumes, proportions and weapons. Use the storyboard to guide key poses, combat flow, screen direction and camera movement.

Motion Phrase 1
The red fighter cuts the main fate thread. The teal fighter drops from the upper beams and kicks her weapon hand, sending her sliding across the wooden stage.

Motion Phrase 2
The red fighter anchors her chain blade into a beam and pulls herself back like a projectile. She traps the teal fighter’s leg and throws her through several hanging curtains.

Motion Phrase 3
A fast chase through a narrow corridor. The teal fighter releases one anchored thread and uses the remaining tension to change direction. The incoming strike misses, followed by a counterattack from behind and a close-range weapon lock.

Motion Phrase 4
Both fighters pull against the chain and fate threads until the force explodes. They are launched in opposite directions, crash onto the wet roof and immediately re-enter the fight. End with a glowing soul-thread revealed between them as the opera house collapses into the storm.

The camera follows the current attacker’s momentum through extreme close-ups, low tracking, weapon POV, whip pans, falling follow shots and short 90–120° orbits during close contact.

Avoid static two-shots, repeated symmetrical compositions, stationary spellcasting, random cuts and long 360° camera orbits.

设计一张高密度实验字体文化海报。

不要在普通字体上简单添加特效，而是使用点阵、弧线、波纹、放射线、栅格或扫描线直接重新构造【主标题】。不同文字使用不同但相关的点线机制，并形成连续变化，例如点阵 → 弧线 → 波纹 → 放射 / 栅格。

主标题占画面约 65%–70%。通过疏密、线距、曲率、压缩、拉伸和局部消失形成字形，允许少量牺牲可读性换取更强设计感。

加入明显的多层 Typography：巨大中文主标题 + 较大的中英文关键词 + 微型编辑文字 + 完整活动信息。不同尺度文字需要真正参与构图，而不是只做说明。

使用深色背景、浅色主图形和一种【强调色】。强调色只用于局部节点和关键词，保持克制。

下方保留完整编辑式信息区，采用不同栏宽、轻微错位、局部竖排与长短不一的分隔线，避免平均四栏、PPT 或 UI 卡片感。

整体要求密而有序、点线连续、文字层级丰富，远看有冲击，近看有细节。

不添加摄影、人物、3D、霓虹、随机乱码、二维码、水印、四角星芒和画面编号。只输出一张完整 9:16 海报。

prompts.text:
Prompt：

【主题】：____
【中文主标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【中心主体】：____
【压角方式】：四角文字压 / 双角对压 / 三角围压+一角释放 / 单角重压+对角回应
【角部元素】：大型中文字 / 色块 / 信息区 / 图案
【辅助纹样】：____
【主色调】：____
【强调色】：____
【日期 / 机构】：____
【比例】：9:16

生成一张具有成熟文化展览与 Editorial Graphic Design 气质的「压角构图」海报。

核心不是简单把文字放进四个角，而是利用画面边缘的大型 Typography、色块、信息区或图案向内部施加视觉压力，把中心主体自然“夹”出来。

中心主体保持完整、稳定、有明确视觉重量，不要为了配合构图故意倾斜或变形。主体约承担 40%–60% 的视觉重量。

根据【压角方式】组织版面：

四角文字压：
四个角都有视觉元素，但必须有明显主次，1–2 个角承担主要重量，其余角只做辅助，不要四角一样大。

双角对压：
选择两个对角作为主要压力点，让大型标题或色块从两个方向夹住主体，另外两角仅安排小型信息。

三角围压 + 一角释放：
三个角形成视觉包围，第四个角刻意保持较轻，让画面有呼吸感。

单角重压 + 对角回应：
一个角使用超大文字或强色块承担主要压力，对角只用较小元素回应，中间主体保持稳定。

大型中文标题必须真正参与构图，可局部裁边、贴边、与主体轻微叠压，但保持清晰可读。

英文标题、日期、机构、主题说明等小型文字集中在 2–3 个区域，通过超大中文、中号标题、极小信息形成明显字号层级。

背景不能完全空白，可加入与主题相关的极淡纹样、档案信息、结构图、材料纹理或说明残影，让留白“有内容”，但不能抢主体。

整张海报只使用一套主要辅助纹样，并且必须与主题产生真实关系,色彩控制在 3–5 个主要颜色，同一张海报必须有明确色彩立场。

整体信息密度中等偏高，但视觉层级清楚：
第一眼看到主体和压角关系；
第二眼看到大型中文标题；
第三眼再阅读英文、日期和辅助信息。

每张海报需要有完整主题和真实内容表达，不要使用大量无意义占位词。即使去掉小字，也应该是一张成立的视觉作品。

整体效果：文化展览海报、杂志编辑设计、成熟印刷出版物感，边缘有压力、中心有聚焦，丰富但不乱。

Prompt:

Create a 9:16 high-fashion editorial poster series with a strong circular composition system.

The overall style should feel like contemporary fashion magazine covers and luxury editorial posters: clean studio setup, minimal background, sharp typography, elegant serif headlines, refined layout, strong negative space, and a polished premium look.

Each image should use circular geometry as the main visual structure, but the circle should be transformed, displaced, opened, or implied in different ways. The model must interact with the structure to create clear depth, movement, and spatial tension.

Keep the layout modern and fashionable, with large English title text, small secondary editorial text, and a clear hierarchy. Avoid logos, watermarks, extra clutter, random symbols, and numbered labels.

For this second set, create four independent poster variations under the same visual system:

1. “IRIS OPEN” — a woman in a metallic silver asymmetric dress stepping through a monumental dark graphite circular aperture made from overlapping curved blades, with a restrained cobalt accent, strong architectural depth, and a sharp futuristic-fashion mood without looking sci-fi.

2. “OFF AXIS” — a dark-skinned woman in a vivid acid-chartreuse dress moving through three large brushed-silver circular slices displaced across different depths, creating strong foreground and background layering with a minimal warm-gray studio setting.

3. “ROUND THE EDGE” — a woman in a deep navy sculptural coat dress walking along a monumental burgundy, dusty-rose, and ivory circular stepped platform, photographed from a high oblique angle, with the body following the curve and the coat creating a secondary motion line.

4. “ABSENT CIRCLE” — a platinum-haired man in deep forest-green tailoring standing between large bone-white and graphite curved architectural panels that create a circular shape entirely through negative space, with a pale blue void at the center and a quiet minimalist mood.

All four images should feel visually unified but clearly different in circular mechanism, perspective, styling, and spatial logic. The first impression should be bold, architectural, clean, and highly design-driven.

Prompt:

Create a bold editorial campaign poster where oversized typography actively shapes the visual concept instead of simply sitting in the background.

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]
Main Word: [SHORT WORD]
Subject / Product: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Typography Function: [SHADOW / FRAME / LIGHT / ROUTE / OTHER]
Main Color: [COLOR]
Accent Color: [COLOR]

Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Use contemporary editorial design, realistic commercial photography, bold oversized typography, and a strong high-contrast color system.

Make the main word extremely large, filling roughly 50–75% of the composition. Allow letters to extend beyond the canvas, be cropped, overlap the subject, or use their negative space as part of the layout.

Most importantly, give the typography a clear visual function. For example, let the letters cast shadows across the subject, frame a product, shape the lighting, create a movement path, or organize the scene in another meaningful way.

The subject or product should interact naturally with this typography system so the text, photography, and graphic elements feel designed as one composition.

Use one dominant color with a contrasting secondary color, black, white, and only a small amount of accent color.

Add a few meaningful campaign details such as the brand name, product name, slogan, specifications, labels, route information, or small editorial text. Keep them organized and relevant to the actual concept instead of using random filler words.

Keep people, products, materials, lighting, and shadows realistic and polished. The final image should feel like a finished commercial campaign key visual — bold, colorful, editorial, and visually complete.

Prompt:

Create a 9:16 retro-tech editorial poster about communication and physical digital interfaces.

Device: [DEVICE]
Headline: [MAIN TITLE]
Concept: [SIGNAL / CALL / INPUT / CONNECTION]
Accent color: [ONE COLOR]

Use a warm off-white editorial background with a realistic retro communication or input device as the hero object. Reference 1990s–2000s technology magazines, telecom manuals, industrial catalogs, Y2K editorial design, and Neo-Swiss typography without copying any existing poster.

Use oversized black typography as part of the composition. Let cables, antennas, signal paths, transparent housings, buttons, screens, or device edges cross through, hide behind, or interrupt the letters so the typography and object feel physically connected.

Visualize the device’s function through meaningful graphics: call timelines, signal paths, cursor movement, dial-up handshakes, connection states, coordinates, waveforms, technical diagrams, status LEDs, interface labels, or hardware specifications. Keep these details small and precise rather than turning the poster into a futuristic UI.

Limit the palette to black, warm white, neutral hardware tones, and one accent color. Keep the product photography realistic with believable transparent plastic, circuitry, metal, cables, screens, and minor material imperfections.

Maintain a strong editorial hierarchy with one dominant object, one dominant headline, a few functional graphic elements, and dense but controlled micro typography. Use clean grids, deliberate cropping, and a small amount of negative space to keep the layout sharp.

Avoid real logos, random text, excessive grunge, heavy distressed printing, cyberpunk neon, multiple accent colors, generic sci-fi HUDs, sparkle symbols, and ordinary centered product-ad layouts.

prompt：https://promptsref.com/tool/AI-Image-Generator/share/7762465b64ad4b8e821b494cb8d56947

create a 2:3 vertical tropical beach vacation portrait with the realism of a smartphone or small digital camera snapshot. The subject is a clearly adult young woman, visually around 21–29 years old, wearing a black low-neck swimwear or lingerie-inspired strappy top with subtle semi-sheer black lace or mesh around the waist and hips. She lies lengthwise across a dark charcoal hammock, her body running diagonally through the composition. Her hips are supported near the center of the hammock, her shoulders are close to the camera-side edge, and her head hangs naturally beyond the edge so that her face appears completely upside down in the photograph. One relaxed forearm crosses the forehead and upper-face area. One leg is bent upward at the knee while the other extends diagonally toward the right side of the hammock, creating an asymmetrical, casually unbalanced pose with believable foreshortening.  Do not turn the pose into a polished swimwear-advertising stance. Her body should look as though it has genuinely settled into the hammock after lying there for some time. Let the waist and back follow the hammock's natural sag, and let gravity produce realistic fabric tension, mild wrinkles and subtle changes in body shape. The black top properly covers the chest while the low neckline reveals some upper-chest and central neckline skin. Do not exaggerate any anatomy. Visible skin includes the face, neck, shoulders, upper chest, upper arms, forearms, hands, abdomen, sides of the waist, parts of the hips, most of the thighs and lower legs, and the feet. The pelvis and area near the buttocks remain mostly obscured by black fabric, semi-sheer material and the hammock. Use fair-to-light neutral skin that becomes slightly cooler in shade and gently warmer where sunlight or reflected sand reaches it. Preserve fine pores, subtle tonal irregularity, natural joint texture and tiny variations in the skin surface. It should visually suggest soft, fine-textured human skin with a slightly warm, dry seaside feel rather than plastic smoothness, waxiness or oily shine.  Her hair is natural black to very dark brown and long enough to fall well below the shoulders. Because her head is hanging beyond the hammock edge, gravity pulls the hair almost vertically toward the sand, with the ends approaching the ground. Avoid perfectly blow-dried commercial hair. Retain separated locks, flyaways, tiny loose strands, slight tangling and mild disorder from the sea breeze. The inverted face is oriented roughly toward the camera. Eye contact is near the lens but does not have to be surgically precise; the expression is quiet, languid and casually attentive. The lips remain naturally closed or barely relaxed. If a face reference is provided, retain its original proportions, eye shape, nose, lips and natural asymmetry rather than replacing it with a celebrity or generic influencer face. Makeup should follow a light Asian social-media beauty aesthetic, closer to subtle K-beauty or Xiaohongshu styling: sheer base, softly shaped brows, restrained eyeliner and lashes, and muted nude or dusty-rose lips. Avoid heavy smoky eyes, strong contouring and excessive highlight.  Position the camera on the side of the hammock nearest her head, slightly above hammock height and angled gently downward. Use the visual perspective of a smartphone main camera or small digital camera with a 28–35mm full-frame-equivalent field of view. The head, chest and upper torso sit closest to the lens and therefore appear mildly larger, while the legs recede deeper into the frame. The framing should approach a full-body environmental portrait, but remain intentionally imperfect: the woman occupies most of the lower half; her inverted head sits close to the lower edge; the hammock cuts diagonally from lower left toward upper right; the ocean horizon sits slightly above the center; a palm trunk and broad palm fronds enter abruptly from the upper-right corner; and a large amount of blue sky remains as negative space. Preserve this slightly unstable, off-center, accidental framing rather than correcting everything into symmetry.  The background is a bright tropical white-sand beach. Calm clear water stretches horizontally through the middle of the frame, shifting from pale turquoise and cyan near shore toward deeper blue in the distance, with a clean horizon line. Above it is a saturated blue sky filled with large, soft-edged white cumulus clouds. Keep the palm tree in the upper-right corner, with dark green fronds creating a natural frame. The sand is pale warm beige-white. Irregular palm-leaf shadows are visible across the beach and hammock. The hammock itself is dark charcoal fabric, with a visible wooden spreader bar and suspension ropes toward the right.  Lighting must feel like real tropical midday to early-afternoon sun. The ocean, beach, clouds and sky in the distance are exposed to unobstructed sunlight and therefore appear very bright. The woman is mostly under open palm-tree shade, making the foreground body noticeably darker than the brilliant ocean-and-sky background. Small openings between palm leaves allow occasional direct sunlight to create random, relatively hard-edged patches across the legs, arms, torso, hammock and sand. Pale sand provides soft warm bounce from below, while the blue sky and turquoise ocean introduce a faint cool ambient reflection into the shaded skin. Do not use flash, softboxes, studio fill lights or artificial rim lighting, and do not flatten every shadow into perfectly even illumination.  Color can retain the reference image's slightly heightened digital saturation: vivid blue sky, bright turquoise water, deep green palm leaves, pale skin and black clothing forming strong contrast. Add modest digital sharpening, very fine image noise and a hint of natural compression texture. A mild smartphone-HDR impression is acceptable, but avoid visible HDR halos. Keep the woman comparatively sharp while allowing the ocean, clouds and palm foliage to soften slightly without becoming unrecognizable. Avoid extreme f/1.2-style creamy background blur.  The emotional tone should resemble a private vacation photo casually taken by a travel companion rather than a commercial campaign. She had already been lying in the hammock for a while and had just allowed her head to fall over the edge. Now her long hair is still being pulled toward the sand by gravity while palm shadows slowly move across her body and the hammock. In another second, she may laugh, shift her position and pull herself upright again. Preserve the physical feeling of escaping harsh afternoon heat under palm shade, together with the slightly dreamlike sense of inversion and weightlessness created by the upside-down pose. Prompt:

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]
Main Word: [SHORT WORD]
Mechanism: [FLUID FLOW / POWER TRANSMISSION / OPTICAL PATH / MECHANICAL MOVEMENT / OTHER]
Subject / Product: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Main Color: [COLOR]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Campaign Details: [SLOGAN / SPECS / DATE]
Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Create a bold editorial campaign poster where oversized typography becomes a functional mechanism inside the composition.

Make the main word extremely large, filling around 60–80% of the frame. Keep the typography clearly readable, but integrate a real working system inside or through the letters.

The mechanism should follow one continuous and understandable path across the word. For example, liquid can flow through the letters, gears can transfer movement, chains can transmit power, or light can pass through lenses and prisms.

Each part of the typography should have a clear function instead of using random mechanical details. Show realistic connections, materials, pressure, movement, reflections, shadows, and physical interaction so the system feels believable.

Connect the typography directly to the featured product. The product should act as the source, input, output, or final result of the mechanism rather than sitting separately beside the text.

Use realistic commercial photography, bold high-contrast colors, clean editorial composition, and a small amount of meaningful product information such as specs, callouts, labels, or a slogan.

Keep the information organized and secondary to the main typography and product.

The final image should feel like a finished commercial campaign key visual — bold, functional, colorful, precise, and visually complete.

生成一张具有强动势和成熟 Editorial Design 气质的「中轴夹景」文化海报。

先建立一条明确、稳定的中央硬轴，可以是船身、竹脊、箭矢、器物结构或其他纵向主体；再让左右两侧的重复元素、弧线、斜线或波纹共同把视觉力量压向中央。

左右元素不只是装饰，而要真正参与方向感和节奏。可以使用桨阵、骨架、弓身、声波、羽翼、杆件等形成连续视觉序列，通过重复、放射、倾斜和尺度变化制造动势。

画面要有一个非常清楚的第一视觉大形：中央硬轴 + 两侧方向性结构。左右视觉重量保持平衡，但不要机械镜像，允许角度、尺度、材质和节奏存在变化。

Typography 根据主体方向重新设计，可以横跨结构、贴近硬轴、沿大形排布或局部错位，不要固定使用四字纵排、巨大单字居中或同一种标题模板。

可加入一个很小的结构研究模块，例如动作阶段、受力、波纹、骨架或路径示意，面积控制在 5%–7%，增加“设计研究感”，但不要做成 PPT 或教学图。

色彩控制在 3–5 个主要颜色，使用明确的大色域和强主体反差。

第一眼看到大形和动势，第二眼看到中轴和标题，第三眼发现两侧元素如何共同制造方向与张力。

避免：机械对称、重复元素完全复制、主体过小、方向混乱、多个视觉中心、复杂技术参数、PPT 信息框、随机装饰线、过度做旧、斑驳噪点和低完成度 AI 海报感。

提示词：

做一张 9:16 竖版东方文化艺术海报，核心方法是“强主体 + 巨型野字 + 明确动势”。

背景使用干净温暖的象牙白艺术纸，保留轻微纸张纹理。不要复杂背景，不要脏污做旧，不要模板化排版，让大面积留白成为画面的一部分。

画面里使用两个超大的黑色毛笔字作为主要视觉骨架。书法要粗重、野性、自由，带明显提按、飞白和真实墨迹边缘。两个字不要排得太工整，可以错位、压叠、上下呼应，部分笔画直接出画。

在画面中央放置一个强主体器物，主体必须足够大、轮廓足够清楚，并且有真实体积、材质和结构。主体可以是纸鸢、大鼓、折扇、长刃，或其他具有强识别度的东方器物。

最重要的是，让主体和野字发生一个一眼就能看懂的动态关系。不要只是把器物摆在字前面，而是让主体真正改变文字：可以破框、冲击、放射、斜切、拉开、穿插、推动，或者让笔画随着主体的方向和力量发生变化。

整体构图要有一条非常明确的动势线。可以是斜向破框、放射展开、正面冲击，或一条强烈的切割轴。让观众一眼就感到画面在“动”，而不是静态陈列。

版式上采用非对称编辑设计。中央区域负责“强主体 + 巨型野字 + 动势关系”，左右边缘再加入小尺寸展览信息、日期、地点和材质说明，让画面既有视觉冲击，也有文化展览海报的出版感。

加入少量自然手写英文标题，像设计师后来补上的注释。英文不要太大，主要起到节奏调节作用。可以再加入极少量朱红印章作为点缀，但不要堆太多装饰元素。

整体配色控制为暖象牙白、深墨黑，再加一个主体本身的主色。比如纸鸢可带少量朱砂红，大鼓可用深红鼓身，折扇可用米白加红刷痕，长刃则以冷银灰为主。颜色不要太杂。

最终效果要像高完成度的东方展览海报：主体够强，字够野，方向够明确，画面张力直接拉满。适合传统工艺、东方文化和展览视觉这类海报参考。

避免人物、普通产品广告、电商摆拍、国潮插画、红金节庆感、霓虹科技感、廉价 CGI，以及无意义的墨点堆积。

She looks straight upward into the camera with a calm, slightly tired, self-contained gaze. Her lips remain naturally closed or only faintly relaxed apart, without a clear smile. The expression should feel like someone who is completely aware of being photographed after the party has already happened, yet is not trying too hard to perform for the camera.  The most important gesture is one arm reaching aggressively upward toward the camera while offering a single banknote. 【压角方式】：四角文字压 / 双角对压 / 三角围压+一角释放 / 单角重压+对角回应
【角部元素】：大型中文字 / 色块 / 信息区 / 图案
【辅助纹样】：____
【主色调】：____

【日期 / 机构】：____

生成一张具有成熟文化展览与 Editorial Graphic Design 气质的「压角构图」海报。

核心不是简单把文字放进四个角，而是利用画面边缘的大型 Typography、色块、信息区或图案向内部施加视觉压力，把中心主体自然“夹”出来。

中心主体保持完整、稳定、有明确视觉重量，不要为了配合构图故意倾斜或变形。主体约承担 40%–60% 的视觉重量。

根据【压角方式】组织版面：

四角文字压：
四个角都有视觉元素，但必须有明显主次，1–2 个角承担主要重量，其余角只做辅助，不要四角一样大。

双角对压：
选择两个对角作为主要压力点，让大型标题或色块从两个方向夹住主体，另外两角仅安排小型信息。

三角围压 + 一角释放：
三个角形成视觉包围，第四个角刻意保持较轻，让画面有呼吸感。

单角重压 + 对角回应：
一个角使用超大文字或强色块承担主要压力，对角只用较小元素回应，中间主体保持稳定。

大型中文标题必须真正参与构图，可局部裁边、贴边、与主体轻微叠压，但保持清晰可读。

英文标题、日期、机构、主题说明等小型文字集中在 2–3 个区域，通过超大中文、中号标题、极小信息形成明显字号层级。

背景不能完全空白，可加入与主题相关的极淡纹样、档案信息、结构图、材料纹理或说明残影，让留白“有内容”，但不能抢主体。

整张海报只使用一套主要辅助纹样，并且必须与主题产生真实关系,色彩控制在 3–5 个主要颜色，同一张海报必须有明确色彩立场。

整体信息密度中等偏高，但视觉层级清楚：
第一眼看到主体和压角关系；
第二眼看到大型中文标题；
第三眼再阅读英文、日期和辅助信息。

每张海报需要有完整主题和真实内容表达，不要使用大量无意义占位词。即使去掉小字，也应该是一张成立的视觉作品。

整体效果：文化展览海报、杂志编辑设计、成熟印刷出版物感，边缘有压力、中心有聚焦，丰富但不乱。
